about: Limits read by scripts/check-containment.mjs (pnpm check:containment). plainNames: a listed word, as a whole word or one part of a camelCase or snake_case name, may not appear in a tracked path outside `paths`, and a scanned text file may not hold more of them than its number in `files` (no entry means none). Documents are not scanned for content (skipPrefixes, skipSuffixes): they record the old names; their paths are still judged. tools: the number of package scripts and of tracked files under scripts/ may not pass these numbers. worktrees: this machine's worktree and local branch counts may not pass these limits. Each mode is off, observe (prints, passes) or enforce. `--update` only lowers numbers; `--allow-increase <path|tools>` raises one entry and is a reviewed decision, because this file is a gate file.
